name: Service Level Objectives
description: Service Level Objectives standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-SLO applies.

rules.title: Define user-centered service level indicators
rules.detail: Choose measurable availability, latency, correctness or freshness signals that reflect user-visible service rather than infrastructure uptime alone.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define user-centered service level indicators.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define user-centered service level indicators.

rules.title: Set explicit SLO targets and windows
rules.detail: Each critical service/flow defines target percentage/threshold and measurement window with clear inclusion/exclusion rules.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Set explicit SLO targets and windows.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Set explicit SLO targets and windows.

rules.title: Track error budget
rules.detail: Calculate remaining budget and use it to guide release/risk decisions when reliability materially misses target.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Track error budget.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Track error budget.

rules.title: Alert on actionable burn rate
rules.detail: Prefer alerts that indicate likely SLO exhaustion and require action rather than noisy threshold-only infrastructure alerts.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Alert on actionable burn rate.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Alert on actionable burn rate.

rules.title: Align SLOs with dependency and business criticality
rules.detail: Do not promise a stronger end-to-end SLO than dependencies and architecture can realistically support without mitigation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Align SLOs with dependency and business criticality.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Align SLOs with dependency and business criticality.

rules.title: Review SLOs using production evidence
rules.detail: Periodically adjust indicators/targets when they no longer represent user impact, while preserving historical comparability.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Review SLOs using production evidence.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Review SLOs using production evidence.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-SLO applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Service Level Objectives to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Service Level Objectives is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Service Level Objectives failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
